newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Amcor shares rise on re-organisation plan.
newsitem.headline: Amcor shares rise on re-organisation plan.

text.p: Shares in Australian-based paper and packaging group Amcor Ltd rose 24 cents or three percent to A$8.25 in active late Thursday trade after Amcor confirmed a re-organisation of its structure aimed at cutting costs and restoring profitability.
Brokers said Amcor had firmed through the day on speculation the re-organisation was about to be announced and was given a boost by the mid-afternoon announcement itself.
"There'd been speculation around about it for a while," said Peake Lands Kirwan broker Kevin Lourey.
